metrics.label: 退款率
metrics.description: 退款订单数 ÷ 已支付订单数（按单量计算，不是按金额）。

numbers.formula: 百分点差 = (退款率 B − A) × 100

queries.title: 退款率
queries.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    THEN '2026-09'
    ELSE '2025-09'
  END AS period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN o.order_id END) AS refunded_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0),
    4
  ) AS refund_rate
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND (
    o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    OR o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2025-09-30'
  )
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    THEN '2026-09'
    ELSE '2025-09'
  END
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 1000
